subject: Re: Public Records Request #DE-2026-1847 - Prerequisite Requirements
body:
Ms. Wei,

Regarding your request for LLC ownership documents related to Pacific Star Maritime Holdings LLC (File #6847293):

Delaware corporate records require proof of vessel registration from the jurisdiction of registry before releasing beneficial ownership documentation for maritime-related entities. This is standard procedure under our cross-border maritime compliance framework.

Acceptable proof includes:
- Official vessel registration certificate from Panama Maritime Authority
- Notarized vessel survey report with IMO number verification
- Lloyd's Register insurance certificate showing current vessel ownership
- IMO Global Integrated Shipping Information System (GISIS) official printout

Once you provide one of these documents, we can process your request. Standard processing time is 10 business days from receipt of prerequisite documentation.

Certificates of Good Standing (corporate standing certificates) are valid for 30 days from issuance date.

Best regards,
Maria Chen
Public Records Coordinator
Delaware Division of Corporations

subject: Maritime Insurance Compliance Records Request - IMO 9467234

The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore requires the following documentation before releasing insurance compliance records for foreign-flagged vessels:

1. Corporate ownership documentation from jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware)
2. Current vessel registration certificate from flag state (Panama)

Both Delaware and Panama documents must be provided together, as our compliance framework cross-references beneficial ownership against flag state registration to prevent shell company obfuscation.

subject: Re: Vessel Survey Report Request - IMO 9467234
body:
Dear Ms. Wei,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding vessel survey documentation for IMO 9467234 (M/V Pacific Horizon).

Lloyd's Register maintains classification survey reports for vessels under our registry. Our records show IMO 9467234 underwent Special Survey on 2025-09-12 at Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

The survey report includes:
- Vessel particulars and ownership declaration (as declared by registered owner)
- Hull and machinery inspection results
- Certificate of Class renewal documentation

Please note: Ownership information in survey reports reflects declarations made by the registered owner at time of survey. Lloyd's Register does not independently verify beneficial ownership or corporate structure.

Survey reports are available to:
1. Registered owners and operators
2. Port state control authorities
3. Authorized maritime insurance underwriters
4. Parties with documented legal interest in the vessel

If you represent a qualified party, please provide authorization documentation. Processing time: 3-5 business days after verification.

Alternatively, basic vessel particulars (excluding ownership details) are available via Lloyd's Register Fairplay at https://www.lrfairplay.com

Best regards,
Lloyd's Register
Vessel Documentation Services
